project_name: WriteQuest — Writer's Quest Blueprint Kit Landing Page

brand_identity.concept: Tactile Working Notebook & Literary Craft Studio
brand_identity.tone: Intellectual, authoritative, tactile, deeply inspiring, structured
brand_identity.hook: You have a story. You don't have a system.
brand_identity.sub_hook: Transform chaotic flashes of inspiration into a publishable manuscript with the beat-by-beat blueprint system built for serious novelists and screenwriters.

typography.font_family_body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Strict 8pt grid system using standard Tailwind increments (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24)
layout_and_spacing.notebook_margins: Relative margin line on left edge (border-l-2 border-[#C83B2D]/30 pl-4 sm:pl-8)
layout_and_spacing.border_style: 1px solid #E5DFD3 with subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg or rounded-xl) resembling bound stationery

key_components.name: Header & Navigation
key_components.description: Sticky paper header with backdrop blur, brand emblem, progress indicator, and quick Buy CTA button
features: Logo emblem with fountain pen nib icon

key_components.name: Kinetic Masked Hero
key_components.description: High-impact hero section with line-by-line staggered text reveal, interactive 3D/Parallax story notebook card tilt, red margin notes, and primary CTA

key_components.name: Editorial Marquee
key_components.description: Slow, elegant kinetic texture ribbon featuring quotes from legendary story architects and key principles

key_components.name: Interactive 4-Framework Showcase
key_components.description: Deep-dive tabbed or card-based interactive engine comparing Three-Act Structure, Hero's Journey, Save the Cat, and Dan Harmon's Story Circle

key_components.name: Numbered Manifesto Chapters
key_components.description: Editorial chapter cards detailing the 5 principles of the WriteQuest methodology
features: Highlighter accents on core thesis lines

key_components.name: Product Preview Gallery with Zoom Modals
key_components.description: Interactive showcase of digital assets included in the blueprint kit: Notion Master Dashboard, Printable Plotting Worksheets, Excel Beat Tracker, Character Arc Matrix
features: High-res screenshot cards with spotlight zoom button

key_components.name: What's Inside Component Breakdown
key_components.description: Detailed grid inventory of every file, template, guide, and prompt system in the ₹599 kit

key_components.name: Single-Tier Pricing Card
key_components.description: High-conversion pricing box anchored at ₹599 (INR) with instant Razorpay checkout button, 100% money-back guarantee seal, and value breakdown
features: Razorpay SDK integration / mock fallback trigger

key_components.name: Sticky Mobile Conversion Bar
key_components.description: Fixed bottom bar on mobile screens (< 768px) with quick price tag and Checkout button
features: Auto-hides in hero, pops up on scroll

key_components.name: FAQ Accordion
key_components.description: Collapsible accordion addressing common author questions regarding tools, compatibility, refund policy, and delivery

key_components.name: Order Success State & Delivery Log Modal
key_components.description: Fulfillment screen displaying instantaneous access links for Notion, PDF, and XLSX templates along with mocked delivery log email details
features: Mocked email delivery timestamp & log toggle

motion_and_effects.animations: Framer motion entrance reveals with staggered line text masking
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Tactile lift effect (hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300)
motion_and_effects.highlighter_effect: CSS background yellow mark behind key headline text

testing_and_accessibility.wcag_level: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios across parchment and ink elements
testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All key interactive buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, and modals MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the tactile working notebook aesthetic using parchment #F9F7F1 background, ink black #1F2022 typography, red pen #C83B2D margin notes, and highlighter yellow #F2E29F accents.
Implement Framer Motion entrance animations with line-by-line masked text reveals in the Hero section.
Support single-tier pricing at ₹599 INR with Razorpay integration and mocked order completion flow.
Include zoom modals for the product gallery images (Notion dashboard, printable worksheets, Excel tracker).
Ensure all interactive components have explicit data-testid attributes.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for high-end feel.
